notes.title: New management sim Gladiators of Citadelum handles the joy of ancient logistics
notes.content:
What springs to mind when you think of the Roman Empire? Is it the insatiable need for expansion? The culture? Or perhaps even the great rulers like Caesar and Augustus? For me, the dilapidated ruins of the Colosseum flash across my mind - the building stands tall as the perfect representation of the everyday Roman people, and the architecture they'd see as they went about their lives. If you've always wanted to know what the fights in the Colosseum were like, then, wonder no longer. Upcoming management sim Gladiators of Citadelum puts you in control of a burgeoning league of warriors, but you'll remain perfectly safe.
